title: Photographer Crawford and the Silas Green picture
summary: Allen recalls a photographer who took Punch's picture with Silas Green in Mississippi; Punch says he has played only a little since coming back.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

blocks.x: And let's see, that fellow Crawford.
It was in October, November, October.
Remember this fellow Crawford, the photographer of Ralston, he took your picture when you were with Silas Green, right? Yeah. Up in Mississippi.
Yeah, well we'll check the date on that, he'll have the date on that picture. Let me see now, so you've been here, and who have you worked with?
Well I just had a little outfit here myself, since I've been here. I haven't been doing much playing, I work more as I, the work I did more of that here since I've been here.
